He had kept the lighthouse for thirty years, but this was the first time the sea had delivered him a promise to keep.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还浸在浓稠的夜色里，鳞次栉比的楼宇只亮着零星几盏窗灯，像散落在黑绒上的碎星。主干道上没有白日的车流喧嚣，只有清洁车慢悠悠扫过路面，带起几片被夜风吹落的梧桐叶。24小时便利店的暖光从玻璃门透出来，值夜班的店员趴在柜台上打盹，偶尔有晚归的代驾司机停在路边买一瓶水。巷口的早餐铺已经升起了白汽，蒸笼里的包子慢慢透出麦香，再过两个小时，这座城市就会从睡梦里慢慢醒转，重新填满人声与烟火。", "w03": "- Imagine you have a set of nested Russian dolls: to get to the smallest doll, you open each big doll one by one, and stop when you can’t open any more.\n- Recursion works just like that: a problem that can be split into smaller, identical versions of itself calls the same solution over and over on the smaller pieces.\n- It always has a stopping rule, just like stopping when you reach the tiny solid doll that can’t be opened, so it doesn’t keep going forever."}
